profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company, traded as SNPS, headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with SEC CIK 0000883241. Its site describes it as delivering silicon-to-systems solutions spanning EDA tools, semiconductor IP and systems verification, which the company says help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk and drive breakthroughs. The site also highlights work on power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on Samsung Foundry processes, presented at SAFE Forum 2026.

On the AI side, the site hosts an AI-powered chatbot that gives general information about Synopsys, its products and its services. A notice states the chatbot may be incorrect or incomplete, that the terms of applicable agreements supersede anything it provides, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool.

The company's litigation exposure is listed in California, with 281 cases. No specific products, MCP servers or individual cases are recorded for it.
